blocks.text: The SexBomb Girls are back in the music scene with “Mama Mama,” their first new song in nearly two decades. Initially released on Aug. 7, the single marks the iconic girl group’s return to recording following major releases “Sumayaw, Sumunod: The Best of the SexBomb Girls” in 2005 and “Daisy Siete: V-Day” in 2006. The comeback also marks a new role for founding member and group leader Rochelle Pangilinan, who served as co-producer of “Mama Mama.” Perry Lansigan composed and produced the song.
